title: Reflavored by SasquatchMike
description: A mod that seeks to enhance the vanilla minecraft experience!
body:
REQUIRES TERRABLENDER AND GECKOLIB!

Made in collaboration with Zinc Studios! Reflavored is a vanilla+ mod that seeks out to enhance and "re-flavor" the Minecraft experience with new experiences following a similar design philosophy as Mojang, by adding in new biomes, mobs, items, and much more! Get lost in the massive and towering Redwoods, or frolic through the Lavender Fields, or say hi to a Koala when passing through a savanna! No matter how you play, Reflavor your game today!

Stream the official Reflavored OST where available! https://release.studio/reflavored-original-soundtrack
